title: The clipping on the tavern wall
logline: The 2008 clipping he signed — the one he framed himself — on the tavern's wall behind the bar, between a fishing photo and a license, seen from the end stool by the jukebox. Sixteen years on the wall he lived behind.

panels.composition: A tavern's back-bar wall with a framed newspaper clipping between a fishing photo and a framed license, bottles below, the clipping's comic panel visible but too small to read, dim light.
